title: Verify a second ordinary UI context template

validation: A protected read-only checkpoint query identified source-selected categories for the IN-08 menu. The e128 production CLI turn-to-Action scene served five typed reads and 20 bytes. Evidence: target/validation/units/e128-ui-context-action-cli-04r1f0p0/ and e128-ui-context-action-watch-pair-jkiu_u9u/.

The retained previous 12-frame native address inventory contains five original reads from template 5 and shares the seed/input used by the earlier accepted owner proof. A guarded read-only evidence join verifies the two records differ: target/validation/units/e128-ui-context-ordinary-distinct-iybjczy_/.
limitations: The first evidence join expected a status field in the raw report and failed before guest execution; its corrected retry passed. Other templates and consumers, complete UI extent, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open; no performance measurements.
